remarks: Visit the Listing Brokerage (and/or listing REALTOR®) website to obtain additional information. Move right into this charming, fully detached bungalow featuring a professionally built 2002 addition that blends original character with modern comfort. Major updates include a 2019 furnace, central A/C, premium appliances, new front and rear double doors, plus a 2022 roof and gutters on both the home and detached garage. The home offers original red oak hardwood, laminate and vinyl flooring, quality window coverings, attractive vinyl siding, and a solid, level concrete-slab foundation. Enjoy a single detached garage with automatic opener and a fully fenced, dog-friendly yard. The mostly unfinished basement includes a den/bedroom and flexible workshop or storage space with future development potential. Ideally located near downtown, this is a great fit for professionals, families, or pet lovers seeking a well-maintained, worry-free character home. Interior photos are omitted for occupant privacy.
